title: 1752. Check if Array Is Sorted and Rotated

examples.explanation: [1,2,3,4,5] is the original sorted array. You can rotate the array by x = 2 positions to begin on the element of value 3: [3,4,5,1,2].
There is no sorted array once rotated that can make nums.
[1,2,3] is the original sorted array. You can rotate the array by x = 0 positions (i.e. no rotation) to make nums.
